 "data": "---
title: Agentic Risk Gatekeeper Decision Flow
config:
 layout: elk
---
flowchart TD
 A[\"Quant Signal Triggered:<br>Ticker A & B\"] --> B{\"Qdrant Metadata Check:<br>Filing < 7 Days?\"}

 B -->|\"No Filings Found\"| C[\"Instant GO Decision<br>(0ms Latency)\"]
 B -->|\"Filing Found\"| D[\"Wake Up<br>LLM Risk Agent\"]

 D --> E{\"Evaluate<br>Text Ambiguity\"}

 E -->|\"Clear Risk / Red Flag\"| F[\"Output VETO\"]
 E -->|\"Clear Safety\"| G[\"Output GO\"]
 E -->|\"Ambiguous Text\"| H[\"Autonomous Tool Call:<br>Monte Carlo Simulation\"]

 H --> I[\"Simulate 1,000<br>OU Paths\"]
 I --> J{\"Check Breach<br>Probability\"}

 J -->|\"High Risk (>50%)\"| F
 J -->|\"Low Risk\"| G

 classDef step fill:#dae8fc,stroke:#6c8ebf
 classDef decision fill:#fff2cc,stroke:#d6b656
 classDef agent fill:#e1d5e7,stroke:#9673a6
 classDef go fill:#d5e8d4,stroke:#82b366
 classDef veto fill:#f8cecc,stroke:#b85450

 class A step
 class B,E,J decision
 class D,H,I agent
 class C,G go
 class F veto",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
